items.title: Clarify current implementation baseline and source mapping
items.context: Fix audit findings that existing scope/owner/parallel/baseline surfaces are described as future work. Add a current-status axis and Authority receipt/lifecycle receipt source documents so implementers do not duplicate existing gates.

happy.desc: The roadmap states the current implementation baseline for scope, owner, parallel work, and baseline surfaces, marking what is already implemented versus future work.

edge.desc: Each baseline surface is mapped to its source of truth, including Authority receipt, lifecycle receipt consumption, lifecycle artifact scope, story lifecycle, session ownership, and parallel wave documents where applicable.

adversarial.desc: The repaired docs must not describe existing scope, owner, parallel, baseline, Authority receipt, or lifecycle receipt behavior as merely planned future work.

items.title: Make review escalation and validation requirements mechanical
items.context: Fix audit findings around ambiguous 3x2 predicate, local verdict signature/verifiability wording, and prose-only validation. Add minimal command sets and expected artifact/row ids for the relevant roadmap milestones.

items.title: Specify rollout crosswalk and recovery controls
items.context: Fix audit findings around rollout policy/version binding, in-flight story treatment, false-positive rollback/de-escalation, M11 staging before blockers, milestone-to-rollout crosswalk, and self-hosting emergency bypass.
